row.evidence: Proof's pricing page lists "Proof Command Center (Admin, SSO, SCIM)" only under Premium & Enterprise (custom pricing), and its developer docs describe SCIM 2.0 endpoints at https://api.proof.com/scim/v1/organizations/{organization}/ for IdP provisioning.
row.notes: Notarize now trades as Proof (Notarize, Inc. dba Proof.com); row named for the product sold today, slug kept. Plans: Pro $0/mo + transaction fees, Pro+ $199/mo + fees (API access), Premium & Enterprise custom pricing with Command Center (Admin, SSO, SCIM). Flat platform fee plus per-transaction pricing, so per-user fields are null. SCIM covers Users only (create, get, list with userName filter, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, active=false deprovision, roles owner/admin/employee) and authenticates with an ApiKey header, not a bearer token; no Groups endpoint documented. SAML SSO also offers JIT provisioning with role and child-organization attributes. Security events (audit) API requires Command Center. No Proof app found in the Okta or Entra catalogues.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: Flat platform fee; billing period not stated on the page. Includes API access (transactions), not Command Center.

auth.token_source: Proof API key (Settings >> API Keys, admin role) sent in the ApiKey header; a parent-organization key can manage child organizations

deprovision.notes: active=false marks the identity deprovisioned; DELETE also exists.

roles.how: roles attribute, primary only: owner, admin or employee

limitations.text: Auth is a Proof API key in an ApiKey header rather than a bearer token.
SAML NameID and SCIM userName must match for each user.
Only a primary email and a primary role are supported.

audit_log_api.notes: List Security Events (OCSF) requires Command Center.

user_api.notes: By absence: the developer docs' only user-management endpoints are the SCIM API; the rest of the API covers transactions, documents, organizations and webhooks.
